headline: Revenue and margins grow, but net income dips
summary_short: Cognizant reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $5,481M, up 4.5% y/y and 1.3% q/q, with operating income up 17.3% y/y to $958M; net income of $636M was down 1.4% y/y even as diluted EPS rose 3.8% y/y to $1.36.
summary_long: Revenue reached $5,481M, up 4.5% y/y and 1.3% q/q. Gross profit ($1,829M, +3.6% y/y), operating income ($958M, +17.3% y/y), and EBITDA ($1,031M, +4.1% y/y) all outpaced revenue growth. EBIT was $888M (+4.3% y/y). Net income of $636M fell 1.4% y/y and 3.9% q/q despite the operating-line gains; diluted EPS of $1.36 rose 3.8% y/y but fell 2.2% q/q. No cash-position figure is on this shard.
